verdict: Service in the focus hours is significantly worse than the baseline on late_share, problem_share.

evidence: Weekend problem rate is 2.1x the weekday rate; weekend service changes / planned work likely.
MTA reports 'Planned ROW Work' as 37% of delays on line(s) L (1.2x the system share) in the analysed months.
Adverse-weather days have 4.8x the problem rate (3 adverse days).
MTA reports 'Infrastructure & Equipment' as 45% of delays on line(s) L (1.4x the system share) in the analysed months.
9% of problem arrivals happened while an MTA 'rolling_stock' alert was active for the line (problem rate 80% with an alert vs 42% without, lift 1.9x).
MTA reports 'Police & Medical' as 10% of delays on line(s) L (0.5x the system share) in the analysed months.

recommendations.action: Review car-class reliability for L; pull chronic door/brake defects from peak assignments
recommendations.rationale: Mechanical alerts correlate with problem arrivals.
recommendations.expected_effect: Fewer disabled trains blocking the line.

recommendations.action: Check weekend / late-night planned service changes for L; use alternates other lines at the station
recommendations.rationale: Planned work is announced in advance.

recommendations.action: Review the general-order (planned work) schedule for L; add supplement trains or move work windows off 01:00-02:00, 02:00-03:00
recommendations.rationale: Problems coincide with planned service changes.
recommendations.expected_effect: Planned changes stop degrading the analysed hours.

recommendations.action: Activate the adverse-weather plan (drainage checks, heat-related speed restrictions review, snow plan) on forecast adverse days
recommendations.rationale: Problem rate rises on adverse-weather days.

recommendations.action: Prioritise infrastructure & equipment work orders on the L corridor near 8 Av
recommendations.rationale: Infrastructure categories over-index in MTA-reported delays for the line.

recommendations.action: Stage a spare train set near 8 Av during 01:00-02:00, 02:00-03:00
recommendations.rationale: A ready spare turns a 20-minute gap into a 5-minute one.
recommendations.expected_effect: Caps the size of mechanical-caused gaps.

recommendations.action: On rainy/snowy days budget extra time for L at 8 Av
recommendations.rationale: Weather sensitivity is measurable at this station.
